name: 三界神话完整加强版
group_note: 三界神话「泉州师院」完整加强版 (San Jie Shen Hua, "quanzhou shiyuan" enhanced edition), fifth and final member of the sjsh family cluster. Same lineage as sjshwzb -- byte-for-byte identical bug set: master.lpc has no CHANNEL_D call in log_error()/standard_trace() (§7.60 does not apply), securityd.lpc's valid_read() never overwrites the driver's user arg (§7.59 does not apply), no sited.lpc (no loopback gate). WASM pass fixed: (1) the familiar convertd.lpc byte-level corruption (45 lines, identical 0xce/0xb2/0xee/0x96/0xa3 illegal-character signature at line 258, same 'stray non-UTF8 bytes escaping a closing quote' pattern as sjsh/sjshv150/sjshwzb) -- fixed with the standard byte-level Python script. (2) §8.1-class check_legal_name() i%2 parity gate in adm/daemons/logind.lpc, identical bug and identical fix to sjshwzb: rewrote to check every character via is_chinese(name[i..i]) with no parity gate, corrected length bound from byte-count (2-12) to character-count (1-6). adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc's is_chinese() was already a correct codepoint-range check -- no fix needed. emoted.lpc/message.lpc/channeld.lpc: checked directly, none of the known bugs present or needed. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (this snapshot's wizlist file was empty/whitespace-only, unlike sjshwzb's which already had two other wizards -- wrote it fresh). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session, identical flow to sjshwzb (GB/BIG5 select -> not-a-student gate -> 'new' -> English id -> Chinese name -> admin+regular passwords (must differ) -> email (xxx@xxx.xxx format required) -> optional homepage/ICQ -> gender -> gift-declined -> stat allocation), zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via login banner '您的系统权限目前是：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 11569 .lpc files (11286 written, 72 errors on messy legacy code, 211 unchanged); reverted the same 2 files (panshi_dan.lpc, npc/mm.lpc) as sjshwzb with confirmed pre-existing (author-side, predates this pass) missing-quote corruption re-spaced further by the formatter. No :: parent-call split hits. Diff-reviewed the same case-heavy file (d/calvin/esman.lpc, byte-identical content to sjshwzb's copy) -- clean, no swallowed statements. Diff-reviewed all 4 map.lpc files via whitespace-normalized line-set comparison -- all differences are brace-placement style only (K&R merge), zero content changes. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
